newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business stories.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business stories.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following major business stories on Oct 25:
NEW YORK - Wall Street is shuddering at the prospect of the Democrats regaining control of Congress in next month's elections.

NEW YORK - Jitters about the future of the cable television business shook the industry's biggest player on Wall Street, with stock in Tele-Communications Inc trading at its lowest point in nearly five years.

WASHINGTON - USAir said it will sever all travel ties with British Airways PLC effective March 29, the latest move in an escalating legal fight between the two airlines over British Airway's proposed marketing alliance with American Airlines.
WASHINGTON - AFL-CIO President John Sweeney says that regardless of the outcome of next month's national elections, organized labor already has won by re-emerging as a national political force.
